moa: Multi-kinase inhibitor (VEGFR, FGFR, PDGFR-alpha, RET, KIT)

approval_evidence.quote: LENVIMA is a kinase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of patients with locally recurrent or metastatic, progressive, radioactive iodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer | Revised: 02/2015

series_start_reason: First quarter delivered is Eisai FY2015 Q1 (Apr-Jun 2015, calendar 2015Q2), the earliest quarter printed in any Eisai Reference Data that could be fetched. FDA approved Lenvima in Feb 2015 and the FY2014 Q4 (Jan-Mar 2015) quarterly table is in a document Eisai filed in May 2015 that is not on the JPX copy (JPX host returned no document for TDnet IDs of 2015-2016 filings) and eisai.com/ir/ redirects to the home page from this environment, so calendar 2015Q1 could not be cited. No document fetched states the launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null.
notes: Eisai prints one worldwide line 'Lenvima / Kisplyx (Anticancer agent)' (Lenvima and Kisplyx are the US/RoW and EU brand names of lenvatinib); the FY2016 Q3 Reference Data labels the same line 'Lenvima (Anticancer agent)' with identical figures for FY2015, so the definition is treated as unchanged. Merck's alliance revenue is not used. Values are Eisai's consolidated product revenue (fiscal April-March quarters mapped to calendar quarters, e.g. FY Q1 Apr-Jun = calendar Q2).
